canonical_statement: Provisional scope: for a properly supported classical pseudodifferential operator P with real principal symbol p, the wavefront set of a distribution u outside WF(Pu) is invariant along the Hamiltonian bicharacteristics of p in the characteristic set. The Stage0 wording does not determine the operator class, regularity scale, or local/global variant, so this is not yet a frozen exact claim.
domain_and_universes: Expected domains include a smooth manifold X, distributions u on X, and a classical pseudodifferential operator P; exact bundles, scalar field, symbol class, and universes remain unfrozen.
quantifiers: P: properly supported classical pseudodifferential operator (order and bundle data open)
rho: point of the characteristic set outside WF(Pu)
hypotheses: the principal symbol p of P is real
P is of real principal type near the bicharacteristic under consideration
the relevant Hamilton orbit remains in the stated microlocal neighborhood
conclusion: Membership of WF(u) is constant along the relevant maximally extended null bicharacteristic, subject to the exact local/global formulation selected from the source.
degenerate_and_boundary_cases: elliptic points p != 0 are governed by microlocal elliptic regularity, not the propagation branch
Hamilton vector field H_p = 0 is excluded by real-principal-type hypotheses in the standard theorem
points in WF(Pu) are excluded from the homogeneous propagation assertion
manifold boundary and radial-point variants are out of scope unless a primary source explicitly selects them
